$comment: Palette migration rules for the Phase 2 codemod. Generated from a measured
inventory of every colour literal in src/ (1,107 uses, 336 distinct values).
See DESIGN_SYSTEM_PLAN.md and the palette decision sheet.
SCOPE IS DELIBERATELY NARROW. Only literals used as UI chrome are mapped.
The codemod MUST skip: any literal inside a linear-gradient()/radial-gradient()
string (309 uses, illustration not chrome), anything in mock-*/demo-scenarios/
persona fixture files (82 uses), and any colour absent from `map` below
(239 tail one-offs). Standardising those would be wrong, not merely unprofitable.

skip.unmapped_colours: leave untouched — do not snap to nearest token

#ff5b2d.note: Always the top stop of linear-gradient(180deg,#ff5b2d,var(--brand)). A real brand gradient partner, not a stray. Give it its own token (e.g. --color-brand-lift) rather than snapping it to brand.

review_before_running.hair-2/hair-3 group: 72 uses lose a green tint and become neutral rules. The only group with a visible change; everything else shifts under delta 15.
